connector.name: Yandex KIT MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Yandex KIT e-commerce API: products, orders, discounts, webhooks and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-yandex-kit. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gistrec account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: YANDEX_KIT_TOKEN
env.description: Yandex KIT API token from the merchant cabinet (Настройки → API → Сгенерировать токен; shown once). Full store access — treat it as a secret.

env.name: YANDEX_KIT_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Yandex KIT API.

env.name: YANDEX_KIT_RPS
env.description: Client-side rate limit in requests per second (the API allows 3 rps per store).
